question: Which form of art was showcased in the show “Vande Bharatam” organised by the Ministry of Culture on the occasion of Republic Day, 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• "Vande Bharatam" showcased a variety of **Indian classical and folk dance forms**.
 
• The event was organized by the **Ministry of Culture** on the occasion of Republic Day, 2023.
 
• The show aimed to **highlight India's cultural diversity** through dance performances.
 
• Participants included **hundreds of dancers** from across the country, representing various dance traditions.
 
• The performances were part of the Republic Day **cultural tableau** celebrations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Classical Dance Forms of India**

 
 
• India recognizes eight classical dance forms: Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Manipuri, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Sattriya, and Mohiniyattam.
 
• Each dance form has its distinct style, music, costume, and storytelling technique.
 
• These dances are rooted in ancient Indian traditions and are performed in temples and on stage.
 
 
 
• **Folk Dances of India**
 
 
• Folk dances are performed during festivals, weddings, and community gatherings.
 
• Popular folk dances include Bhangra, Garba, Dandiya, Ghoomar, and Lavani.
 
• These dances reflect the cultural heritage and traditions of the respective regions.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Culture, Government of India**
 
 
• The Ministry of Culture is responsible for the preservation and promotion of India's cultural heritage.
 
• It oversees various institutions, including museums, libraries, and cultural centers.
 
• The ministry organizes cultural events, festivals, and competitions to promote artistic expression.
 
 
 
• **Republic Day Celebrations**
 
 
• Republic Day is celebrated on January 26th every year to honor the adoption of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The celebrations include a grand parade in New Delhi, showcasing India's military strength and cultural diversity.
 
• Cultural programs, including dance and music performances, are held across the country.
